title: The multi report compares kb and bare agents in tokens and USD per correct answer, verified fact and passing item
goal: the report's multi section gains per case a table of both arms of each record and knob set: tokens (input, output, cache read and cache write summed) and USD per correct answer, per verified fact and per passing item; a column kb minus bare gives each difference with its direction (kb lower, kb higher or equal); a value with no rows behind it (an arm with no bare twin, no correct answer) reads no data, never 0; kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md and README.md are regenerated so benchmarks.py report --check passes

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail

import re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bench_report
KB = "concurrent coord=shared stagger=0 model=default pack_budget=1200 tools=kb manager=code"
SEQ = "sequential coord=shared stagger=0 model=default pack_budget=1200 tools=kb manager=code"
def row(case, arm, metric, value):
    return {"scenario": "multi", "record": "abc1234", "date": "2026-10-20", "commit": "abc1234", "claude_code": "", "kb_topics": "",
            "case": case, "arm": arm, "model": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "metric": metric, "value": str(value), "runs": "1", "note": "planted"}
rows = []
for arm, vals in ((KB, dict(input=1000, out=100, cache_read=8000, cache_write=400, usd=0.5, right=8, asked=10)),
                  ("bare " + KB, dict(input=3000, out=300, cache_read=9000, cache_write=900, usd=0.3, right=5, asked=10)),
                  (SEQ, dict(input=1100, out=110, cache_read=8000, cache_write=400, usd=0.6, right=8, asked=10))):
    rows += [row("lookups", arm, m, v) for m, v in vals.items()]
rows += [row("research", a, m, v) for a, vals in ((KB, dict(usd=8.0, input=5000, out=900, cache_read=90000, cache_write=9000, facts_verified=16)),
                                                   ("bare " + KB, dict(usd=6.0, input=7000, out=800, cache_read=70000, cache_write=7000, facts_matched=4, facts_verified=16)))
         for m, v in vals.items()]
rows += [row("mixed", a, m, v) for a, vals in ((KB, dict(usd=7.0, input=4000, out=700, cache_read=60000, cache_write=6000, items_passed=2, items=2)),
                                                ("bare " + KB, dict(usd=5.0, input=4500, out=600, cache_read=50000, cache_write=5000, items_passed=1, items=2)))
         for m, v in vals.items()]
text = bench_report.multi_tables(rows)
for w in ("per correct answer", "per verified fact", "per passing item", "kb minus bare"):
    assert w in text, (w, text[-1500:])
low = text.lower()
assert "kb higher" in low and "kb lower" in low, "the kb-minus-bare deltas state no direction"
assert "no data" in low, "the sequential arm with no bare twin is not labelled no data"
assert re.search(r"0\.0625|0\.063", text) and re.search(r"0\.06\b|0\.060", text), "usd per correct answer of the two arms not shown"
print("report ok")

notes: Operator request 2026-10-19, verbatim: "give the benchmark that will run today a parallel run of bare agents doing similar work -- need to compare token and dollar efficiency". Tokens are input, output, cache read and cache write summed, and each of the four is kept in its own row too. The direction words are kb lower, kb higher or equal (kb minus bare below, above or at 0). Premise 2026-10-19: bench_report.multi_tables prints no per-answer, per-fact or per-item figure and no kb-minus-bare column. benchmarks.py report --check passes before the work and stays as a guard: it pins that kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md and README.md are regenerated in step with the changed report code; the planted-row check 0 is the one that fails until the work.
